title: Duel
intro: Challenge a friend for seven days. There are no points at stake.
rule: Whoever meets their daily goal on the most days gets the duel badge. Minutes don't count. Equal scores are a tie.
squad_only: You do a duel with someone from your squad. Ask a squad member to challenge you; they then share a duel link in your squad.
link_text: Up for a seven-day duel? Whoever meets their daily goal most often gets the badge. There are no points at stake.
link_validity: This link is valid for 48 hours, for one person.
open: Waiting for acceptance. The other person has 48 hours to join.
expired: Nobody accepted the duel in time. You can start a new duel.
pending_review: The result follows after the check.
won: You took the duel against {name}. The badge is yours.
lost: {name} met the daily goal more often. Good try.
